proposals.mechanism: Concrete MinerMachine constructor installs one persistent BatterySlotTrait named batterySlot with real one-slot storage; UI targets same physical handler, not ghost template. On legacy disk load lacking traitHolder, MetaMachine invokes fixTraitTags before generic annotated reader. chargerInventory is wrapped as storage. putTraitTag queries actual installed traits by class: exactly one named persistent trait sends old payload to traitHolder[actualTraitName]; otherwise sends to root fallback batterySlot. Same routing supports old circuit and auto-output policy fields as one ownership-schema change, not three credits. Actual holder decoder selects existing named trait and feeds same generic reader into its constructed storage. New disk writer stores named trait envelope. On machine load, physical restored battery triggers subscription; real charge/discharge mutates a copy of original stack then writes it back to live slot, updating external machine energy. Destruction emits carried stack then clears.
proposals.dedup: 07cbd already credits ChargerMachine old chargerInventory→batteryInventory field rename and native charge consumer; those primitive inventory/energy mechanics are support0 here. Increment proposed only for observed assembled-sidecar ownership migration: class-cardinality determines whether old physically owned stock must become nested named instance state or remain a root annotated field, before runtime subscriptions bind. 6446 migrates per-side covers through explicit side/type, not installed class cardinality;26f moves an attachment into one fixed object then removes attachment, no ambiguous multi-trait route. No separate credit for helper, @SaveField engine, each trait/slot/key or charge function. If coordinator considers cardinality owner-rehome same existing semantic family, downgrade0 rather than counting this wrapper alone.
limits: Proposed1 is an upper bound pending independent review; total ledger unchanged. Unnamed/multiple/no matching traits use root defaultName rather than select one or retain explicit unresolved migration escrow. If root default field absent, generic reader ignores and next writer may lose orphaned old payload. Concrete verified successful route is one named Miner battery trait only, not every fallback machine.

Presence of any traitHolder suppresses all legacy fixes, even wrong type/empty/partial modern container. Mixed-format root old fields then do not merge. Old source keys not removed locally; helper shares original Tag object under new key rather than deep copy. No crash-safe in-place commit or repeated-load normalization proof.
Circuit and auto-output rewrites read as same algorithm support only. No extra credit requested for their actual consumers; arbitrary machine trait inventories and duplicates not runtime exercised.

Unknown saved trait names warned and skipped, not retained raw. Generic field reader catches errors, skips absent/empty compounds and null sentinel; holder-level exception can stop later entries and be caught only at outer field. No all-entry recovery guarantee.

CustomItemStackHandler overwrites incoming Size with current1 and delegates native ItemStackHandler. Oversized legacy slots may be truncated; native capability/NBT remapping and exact Forge binary codec not expanded here. UI modular slot framework and annotations discovery previously credited support, not runtime tested.

Actual electric charging helper passes false as simulate to electricItem.charge even during simulation, but operates on copied stack and only writes it back when !simulate. Do not claim provider callbacks/capabilities have no external side effects, or that all modded battery implementations are lossless. Native FE branch honors simulate.

BatterySlot storage listener manages subscription; onMachineDestroyed drops then clears without spawn acknowledgment. No transactional delivery guarantee. Entire raw MetaMachine file and generic sync class discovery not audited; only bounded disk bridge, attachment, migration and concrete consumer paths.
No production Java, ledgers, checklist, assets, saves, game, network or Git commit/push modified. Static source research cannot substitute Dynasty native migration/clone tests.
